en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban Bin Usman, from Ajlan Abu Salih who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whenever you end up to the well of Maymoun, or the well of Abdul Samad, so wash, and take off your slippers, and walk bare-footed, and upon you should be the tranquility and dignity’.
en.sarwar: 6. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad all from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from ‘Ajlan abu Salih who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘When you arrive at Bi’r Maymun or Bi’r ‘Abd al- Samad, then take Ghusl (bath), take off your sandals and walk barefoot with calmness and dignity.’”
